svg.title: Spatial basis learned from early actions only
svg.desc: Wyscout 2017/18 | 2017-08-04 to 2017-12-31 | seed 42 First two of five pass components | joint start/end basis has unit L1 mass Native Wyscout coordinates; 50 × 50 cells, Gaussian input sigma=1 cells; nearest-cell display. Fixed reference configuration: 4/4/5/5 components; local 70% variance selection was not performed. One shared colour scale. Aggregate fitted patterns, not occupancy time. Components are not ordered by ability or quality.
